ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { target: vars.baseTarget.host, port: vars.baseTarget.port, path: vars.baseTarget.path, method: vars.baseTarget.method, results: { default: vars.defaultResult, corporate: vars.corporateResult }, trustDifference: if (!vars.defaultResult.success and vars.corporateResult.success) "CORPORATE_TRUST_SUCCEEDED_WHERE_DEFAULT_FAILED" else null }

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java --- { host: attributes.queryParams.host default "", port: attributes.queryParams.port default 443, path: "/", method: "HEAD", trustProfile: "default" }

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { host: vars.target.host, port: vars.target.port, tlsProbe: vars.probe, certificate: null, chain: [], certificateDetailsAvailable: false, limitation: "The standard Mule HTTP connector validates TLS but does not expose the peer X.509 session or certificate chain. This project intentionally has no custom Java certificate client. Use openssl s_client for chain display; the tlsProbe remains authoritative for this Mule runtime's default trust decision." }

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java var r = vars.request default {} --- { host: trim((r.host default "") as String), port: (r.port default 443) as Number, path: (r.path default "/") as String, method: upper((r.method default "GET") as String), trustProfile: lower((r.trustProfile default "default") as String) }

%dw 2.0 output application/java import java!java::net::InetAddress --- InetAddress::getAllByName(vars.target.host) map { ip: $.hostAddress, loopback: $.loopbackAddress, linkLocal: $.linkLocalAddress }

raise-error.description: Target resolves to blocked loopback/link-local address

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json var status = vars.remoteStatus as Number --- vars.target ++ { success: status < 400, dnsResolved: true, tcpConnected: true, tlsHandshake: true, httpConnected: true, statusCode: status, durationMs: ((now() - vars.startedAt) as Number {unit: "milliseconds"}), errorCategory: if (status >= 500) "HTTP_5XX" else if (status >= 400) "HTTP_4XX" else null, muleErrorType: null, errorMessage: null, timestamp: now() as String {format: "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ssXXX"} }

%dw 2.0 output application/json var m = lower(vars.caughtErrorMessage) var category = if ((m contains "pkix") or (m contains "unable to find valid certification path") or (m contains "certificate_unknown")) "TLS_UNTRUSTED_CERTIFICATE" else if ((m contains "hostname") and ((m contains "match") or (m contains "subject alternative"))) "TLS_HOSTNAME_MISMATCH" else if ((m contains "sslhandshake") or (m contains "handshake_failure") or (m contains "tls handshake")) "TLS_HANDSHAKE_FAILURE" else if ((m contains "timed out") or (m contains "timeout")) "CONNECTION_TIMEOUT" else if ((m contains "connection refused")) "CONNECTION_REFUSED" else "UNKNOWN_CONNECTIVITY_ERROR" var tlsFailure = category startsWith "TLS_" --- vars.target ++ { success: false, dnsResolved: true, tcpConnected: if (tlsFailure) true else null, tlsHandshake: if (tlsFailure) false else null, httpConnected: false, statusCode: null, durationMs: ((now() - vars.startedAt) as Number {unit: "milliseconds"}), errorCategory: category, muleErrorType: "HTTP:" ++ vars.caughtErrorType, errorMessage: vars.caughtErrorMessage, timestamp: now() as String {format: "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ssXXX"} }

logger.message: #[write({event: "https_diagnostic", correlationId: correlationId, host: vars.target.host, port: vars.target.port, method: vars.target.method, trustProfile: vars.target.trustProfile, durationMs: payload.durationMs, success: payload.success, statusCode: payload.statusCode, errorCategory: payload.errorCategory, muleErrorType: payload.muleErrorType}, "application/json")]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json var category = error.errorType.identifier --- (vars.target default {}) ++ { success: false, dnsResolved: if (category == "DNS_FAILURE") false else null, tcpConnected: false, tlsHandshake: false, httpConnected: false, statusCode: null, durationMs: null, errorCategory: category, muleErrorType: error.errorType.namespace ++ ":" ++ error.errorType.identifier, errorMessage: error.description, timestamp: now() as String {format: "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ssXXX"} }
